notes.title: No Network Required
notes.content:
Hi Users,

We understand that some have experienced login issues in the past, so we decided
to remove the login and password requirements. The application can also be operated completely offline. Thank you for your continued support.  Your app version should read 1.0,8off after the update. These changes have been made to our WebGL and Oculus Platforms as well. Enjoy learning with Sama Learning VR!

Sama Team

notes.title: Single Device Progress Save
notes.content:
Hi Users!

I'm here to announce a very small update, [b]1.0.8s[/b] (1.7mb)
I improved the soft saving and loading functionality of the app. Lesson progression is tracked to allow users to skip quizzes that were completed previously. Audio and content settings are loaded upon login to allow for unique tailored experiences per userID on a single headset device. 

Best,

Justin

notes.title: Critical Update: Version 1.0.8
notes.content:
Dear Users,

Due to Covid19, our app analytics platform has switched servers. We continue to show our love and support to all during these times. Free username: [b]steam2020 [/b] gives full access to the app for an extended limited time. Stay healthy, stay safe, and "Samaste". 

Yours Truly,

Sama Learning
